Issue Title: Missing conjunction "e" in Italian sync instruction translation
Description: The Italian translation for the mobile "Scan-or-Copy-Code" instruction is missing the conjunction `"e"` (meaning "and") between `"DuckDuckGo"` and `"vai su"`. The English source says "...the DuckDuckGo App **and** go to..." but this variant translates it as `"...DuckDuckGo vai su..."` instead of `"...DuckDuckGo e vai su..."`. The other three closely related "Go to" instruction translations all correctly include the `"e"`, making this an inconsistency in user-facing setup instructions.

Issue Title: Typo "võime" instead of "mine" in Estonian translation
Description: The Estonian translation for the mobile Scan-or-Copy-Code instruction uses `võime` ("we can") instead of `mine` ("go"), making the sentence grammatically incorrect and nonsensical. The three parallel translations of the same "Go to…" pattern at lines 8903, 8914, and 8937 all correctly use `või mine DuckDuckGo rakenduses`, confirming this is a typo.

Issue Title: Confirmation and action labels have identical translation
Description: The new translation for `"Switched to %s"` (a confirmation label shown after the model switch completes) is `"Beralih ke %1$s"`, which is identical to the button label `"Switch to %s"` also translated as `"Beralih ke %1$s"`. Indonesian uses markers like "Sudah" or "Telah" to express completed actions, so the confirmation label loses its distinction from the action button, potentially confusing users about whether the switch actually happened.

Description: The `%1$s` placeholder in `"New device added to %sSync & Backup."` represents a line break (per the translator comment: "%s is a line break so the title wraps after 'to'").
